verdict.rationale: Make can be driven without its UI. It has a token-authenticated REST API, a TypeScript SDK, webhook URLs that external services can call to trigger scenario execution, and an MCP server that runs scenarios. However, nothing documents CI or pipeline usage specifically, and no CLI is shown. missing for 10: a documented CLI or CI integration guide, an explicitly evidenced REST endpoint for running scenarios, a test or sandbox environment for CI runs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: All requests to the Make API require authentication with the user authentication token with the relevant scopes enabled.
webhooks create a url that you can call from an external app or service, or from another use webhooks to trigger the execution
Make MCP server allows AI systems, such as large language models (LLMs), to run scenarios and manage the contents of your Make account.
The Make Typescript SDK provides full support for type definitions and a majority of Make API endpoints, built-in error handling, and response typing.
